subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw expose all five proposed memory roles and per-agent overrides now, despite capture and userModel lacking complete generic invocation contracts?
rationale: These names and semantics become durable plugin and configuration API; implementation work cannot safely decide which still-foundational roles should be permanent.

options.title: Narrow to complete roles
options.body: Ship only roles with end-to-end runtime ownership and add capture or userModel after their invocation protocols exist.

options.title: Finish all five contracts
options.body: Keep the taxonomy but add explicit capture and userModel role execution plus exact-head isolation proof.

options.title: Approve activation-only roles
options.body: Accept that some slots initially express activation and configuration ownership without a generic invocation contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow to complete roles
recommendation.body: Ship only roles with end-to-end runtime ownership and add capture or userModel after their invocation protocols exist.

likelyOwner.reason: The central files show the strongest historical ownership signal for plugin-slot and memory runtime architecture.
